name: Dufs
description: Small file server with uploads, search and WebDAV

paths.name: Config
paths.description: This install's password (.icestore-password). Keep it private.

paths.name: Srv
paths.description: The files Dufs shares: your whole MOS storage (/DATA). Point it at a smaller folder to share less.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Dufs web page and WebDAV, published on host as 6801

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DUFS_USER
variables.description: The user name you sign in with. The password is made on first start and shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.

variables.name: DUFS_ALLOW_ALL
variables.description: true lets the signed-in user upload, delete, search, edit and download folders as zip files. Set to false for read-only downloads.
